title: 36 Hours in Yangon, Myanmar
abstract: The major city of a complicated country, Yangon is hoping to become Southeast Asia’s next boomtown. What can you find during a visit in the meantime? Here’s a look.

title: 36 Hours in Baton Rouge, La.
abstract: It may not be the nonstop party of New Orleans, but Louisiana’s capital city offers plenty, from food to history to the arts.

title: 36 Hours in Upper Manhattan
abstract: Museums and music, cocktails and cuisine, history and Hudson River views are all part of a weekend in this richly textured part of the city.

title: 36 Hours in Kyoto, Japan
abstract: Explore shrines and temples, browse design shops, sample deep-fried food on skewers and more during a weekend in Japan’s former imperial capital.
